name: nettiauto-mcp
description: Nettiauto (automotive): search_listings, get_listing. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_nettiauto_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NETTIAUTO_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_nettiauto_client_id.description: Nettix API client id (Alma Media grants API access to business customers on application); used with grant_type=client_credentials at https://auth.nettix.fi/oauth2/token.

platform_mcp_nettiauto_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_NETTIAUTO_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_nettiauto_client_secret.description: The client's secret. The 24-hour JWT it mints is sent as the X-Access-Token header.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: GET https://api.nettix.fi/rest/car/search (OpenAPI https://api.nettix.fi/docs/car/swagger.yaml): an array of ads for sale. make and model are Nettix option ids (integers from /options/make and /options/model, e.g. make=4), not names; query is free text (searchText); location/condition are not mapped (region/town take option ids). rows ≤ 100.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: GET https://api.nettix.fi/rest/car/ad/{id}: the full car ad (options as {id, fi, en}, images, equipment, seller info in raw).
